No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Zambia Politics: Prophet Jeremiah’s Earlier Prophecy Resurfaces, Sparks Reactions by Ezra Ukanwa 7 seconds ago in Politics Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram Earlier prophetic declarations attributed to Nigerian cleric, Senior Prophet Jeremiah Omoto Fufeyin, about Zambia’s political future have resurfaced on social media, triggering reactions among his followers.
The renewed attention comes amid discussions surrounding President Hakainde Hichilema and developments in Zambia’s political landscape, with some social media users revisiting the cleric’s reported comments on the country’s presidential election.
The discussions have generated reactions, with followers expressing interest in the alleged prophecy and its perceived connection to recent political developments.
A social media user, @grace_nna200, observed that the renewed attention explains why people are revisiting Prophet Jeremiah’s earlier statements.
Similarly, @Yusuf_2030 wrote: “God alone knows tomorrow. More grace to Prophet Jeremiah,” expressing appreciation for the cleric.
Another user, @bolati_to20, suggested that the prophet’s earlier declarations were beginning to make more sense in the light of recent developments.
The reactions have also renewed conversations about the relationship between religious prophecies and political events, particularly how believers interpret declarations concerning the leadership and future of nations.
While some followers view the resurfacing of the statements as significant, the specific declarations and their connection to subsequent political developments remain subjects of interpretation.
The development has once again drawn attention to Prophet Jeremiah’s reported comments about Zambia, with social media users continuing to discuss their possible significance.
